DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome (IC/BPS)

The classic presentation of bladder pain relieved by voiding, significant frequency, nocturia, and dyspareunia in a 40-year-old female, without hematuria or fever, is highly specific for IC/BPS. I will not perform further invasive testing as the clinical picture is sufficient for management.
